title: A Partly Cloudy Crystal Ball
summary: As we celebrate Convene’s 40th anniversary, we’re looking back into our archive. Here’s how two contributors imagined the future at the turn of this century, writing from a world operating with 56K dial-up computer modems and a fax machine in every office.

title: Rachel Smith
summary: Rachel Smith, meeting coordinator at Optica, sees onsite inconveniences as part of the adventure of event planning, an outlook that not only helps her navigate challenges more effectively but also allows her to enjoy the unpredictability that makes live events so dynamic and rewarding.

title: Why ‘Belonging Is Not Downloaded, It Is Experienced’
summary: Cultural strategist José Luis Piñeiro explains why live events, once considered communication tools, are becoming something much bigger — “behavioral architecture” that shapes belonging, identity, and collective meaning.

title: What’s Shaping Live Experiences in 2026?
summary: That’s the question “The Experience Design Report,” based on the survey responses of nearly 450 event professionals, seeks to answer, taking into account everything from educational programming and networking to event tech.

title: 24 Hours in Bourbon City
summary: From spirits to sports to steeds, Louisville packs a punch.

title: This Week on the Convene Podcast: Rethinking Productivity, Designing for Wellness with David T. Stevens, and Events as Cultural Rituals
summary: From Natalie Nixon’s call to reframe productivity for more human-centered meetings, to David T. Stevens’ approach to designing events around wellbeing and performance, to José Luis Piñeiro’s perspective on events as modern rituals — here’s what’s new on the Convene Podcast.

title: How Event Organizers Can Navigate the Latest Geopolitical Challenges
summary: Mitigating risk in a complex and volatile environment.

title: Make Milestone Moments Matter
summary: Five events industry experts share how to plan your organization’s milestone, like a significant anniversary, so it honors the past while pointing the way toward the future.

title: This Positive Trait — Trusting Your Gut — Could Be Holding You Back
summary: One of the biggest roadblocks to event professionals using AI to improve their strategic planning could be an overreliance on their own instincts.

title: Effortless by Design: The Power of Hosting in Boise
summary: In Boise, meetings feel easy by design. From the moment attendees land at Boise Airport — located just seven minutes from downtown — they feel relaxed, with none of the friction that often comes with events in larger metropolitan markets.
